items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know we were talking to Benny Turner and he told us to play with Williamson too and his piano when he was in the Navy. >> [INTERVIEWEE] No I played with Benny too, that's my boy. We used to work for the, across the river.

ctx.x: Oh the trumpet. Yeah. See, where that story is, there's a garage there now. But what I mean, I used to play up on a TikTok up there with, see Clyde Kerr and William Houston had a band up there, and Poirier bought them uniforms and everything, and when I won all them contests and everything, well I never had nobody to book me, if I could have got somebody to book me. Because Lewis Jordan was coming out then with that stuff, with his temperament fire, well I had outfits something like that better than what he had,…
What's the band you play with?
